description: This file contains utility functions, class definitions, and methods for handling Azure-specific operations within the litellm project, including Azure AD token retrieval, header processing, and Azure OpenAI client initialization.

classes.name: AzureOpenAIError
classes.description: Custom exception class for Azure OpenAI related errors, extending BaseLLMException.

classes.name: BaseAzureLLM
classes.description: Base class extending BaseOpenAILLM, providing methods for Azure AD token management and Azure OpenAI client initialization.

methods.name: process_azure_headers
methods.description: Processes headers to extract rate limit and provider-specific information, returning a combined dictionary.

methods.name: get_azure_ad_token_from_entra_id
methods.description: Retrieves an Azure AD token provider callable using tenant ID, client ID, and client secret.

methods.name: get_azure_ad_token_from_username_password
methods.description: Retrieves an Azure AD token provider callable using username and password credentials.

methods.name: get_azure_ad_token_from_oidc
methods.description: Obtains an Azure AD access token from an OIDC token, with caching and error handling.

methods.name: select_azure_base_url_or_endpoint
methods.description: Determines whether to set base_url or azure_endpoint based on the provided URL.

methods.name: get_azure_ad_token
methods.description: Main function to obtain an Azure AD token via various methods, including environment variables, token providers, and different credential flows.

methods.name: _try_get_default_azure_credential_provider
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a default Azure credential token provider if enabled.

methods.name: get_azure_openai_client
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a cached Azure OpenAI client, supporting sync and async clients.

methods.name: initialize_azure_sdk_client
methods.description: Initializes Azure SDK client parameters, including token management and environment variable resolution.

methods.name: _init_azure_client_for_cloudflare_ai_gateway
methods.description: Builds an Azure SDK client configured for Cloudflare AI Gateway, supporting different authentication methods.

methods.name: _base_validate_azure_environment
methods.description: Validates and sets Azure API key or token in headers for environment setup.

methods.name: _get_base_azure_url
methods.description: Constructs the base URL for Azure API calls, handling API versioning and route paths.

methods.name: _is_azure_v1_api_version
methods.description: Checks if the provided API version corresponds to Azure v1 or preview.

methods.name: _resolve_env_var
methods.description: Resolves environment variables for parameters, respecting explicit None values in litellm_params.
